title: Web UI E2E acceptance

context.summary: Add the Web UI Playwright acceptance gate for the supported local MVP browser flow.
context.background: TASK-126 through TASK-130 implemented the UI package, feature workspaces and Docker/installer runtime integration. The remaining UI scope is an explicit browser acceptance command that can run safely in CI as a dry-run and live against a started API/UI stack.

in: Add a root ui:e2e command with CI-safe dry-run coverage validation.
Add live Playwright coverage for bearer-token login, project selection, text fixture upload and document pipeline observation.
Verify jobs, artifacts and source refs in the document workspace.
Verify unified search, manual source-backed memory creation and context preview in the search workspace.
Verify desktop and mobile layouts do not overflow horizontally.
Include the dry-run Web UI E2E gate in pnpm check.
Update README, UI, MVP acceptance, deployment, configuration, support matrix, repository status, PRD and changelog docs.
out: Changing Web UI product features beyond selectors and supported flows already implemented in TASK-126 through TASK-130.
Starting Docker automatically from the UI E2E command.

acceptance_criteria: pnpm ui:e2e validates dry-run coverage and is included in pnpm check.
Live mode uses Playwright to verify login/token entry, document upload, jobs, artifacts/source refs, search, memory, context and desktop/mobile layout against a running stack.
The live script documents MINDORY_UI_E2E_LIVE, MINDORY_UI_E2E_URL, MINDORY_E2E_API_URL and MINDORY_UI_E2E_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE.

README, docs/UI.md, docs/MVP_ACCEPTANCE.md, docs/DEPLOYMENT.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md, docs/REPOSITORY_STATUS.md, docs/PRD.md and CHANGELOG.md describe the supported Web UI E2E gate.
Task registry marks TASK-131 as current and done.

manual_checks: Confirm the live Web UI E2E command is documented for an already-started stack.
Confirm the UI E2E script does not start Docker by itself.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
